The game

Flyway Surfer is an original arcade runner. Use arrows or WASD to switch lanes, jump, and duck. Space jumps, P or Escape pauses. On a phone, swipe or use the buttons. Three hits end a run; 15 clean seconds recover one hit.

Take over at any time. Sound and your best run are saved only on this device.
